sources.summary: A journey showcasing love, the inferiority complex it brought, and how I overcame it. It all started when society brutally declared that expressing love was a 'sin'. An individual suddenly hands you a clean pair of glasses, changes your perspective, just to say, "Love isn't a sin; it's a natural sentiment", giving me a new vision to appreciate art.
